title: The Challenge of Out-Of-Distribution Detection in Motor Imagery BCIs
abstract: arXiv:2603.13324v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Machine Learning classifiers used in Brain-Computer Interfaces make classifications based on the distribution of examples on which they were trained. When exposed to EEG from unfamiliar classes, they can only make blind guesses. Instead of allowing such guesses, these Out-of-Distribution (OOD) samples should be detected and rejected to improve the robustness of BCIs against unfamiliar cognitive states.   We study OOD detection in Motor Imagery BCIs by training a model on some classes and observing whether an unfamiliar movement class can be detected based on increased uncertainty. We tested seven different OOD detection methods and one more method that has been claimed to boost the quality of OOD detection.   For many BCI users, the uncertainty for the familiar in-distribution classes can still be higher than for the out-of-distribution classes, due to the high intrinsic variability inherent in EEG signals. translated_title: 运动想象脑机接口中分布外检测的挑战
translated_abstract: 脑机接口（BCI）中使用的机器学习分类器是基于其训练样本的分布来进行分类的。当接触到来自不熟悉类别的脑电（EEG）信号时，这些分类器只能做出盲目的猜测。与其允许这种猜测，不如对这些分布外（OOD）样本进行检测并加以拒绝，从而提升脑机接口应对不熟悉认知状态的鲁棒性。我们通过在某些类别上训练模型，并观察能否基于不确定性的增加来检测出不熟悉的运动类别，以此研究运动想象脑机接口中的分布外检测问题。我们测试了七种不同的OOD检测方法，以及另一种据称能够提升OOD检测质量的方法。研究发现，对于许多脑机接口用户而言，由于脑电信号本身固有的高度变异性，熟悉的分布内类别的不确定性仍然可能高于分布外类别。因此，许多OOD检测方法（效果不佳）……
tldr: 该研究通过测试多种分布外检测方法发现，由于脑电信号固有的高变异性，许多用户在分布内类别上产生的不确定性反而高于分布外类别，导致运动想象脑机接口中的分布外检测面临严峻挑战。
